overclaims.abstract: Bootstrap mediation analysis (5,000 iterations) confirmed a mediating role of positive mental health.
overclaims.body: The results suggest a small indirect association consistent with a mediation pattern, where positive mental health may function as a mediator between physical activity and depressive symptoms.
overclaims.why: The body describes only a small indirect association consistent with a mediation pattern in which positive mental health may function as a mediator, not a confirmed mediating role.

unsettled: The findings showed significant correlations among the three variables, with positive mental health strongly associated with reduced depressive symptoms.

The findings provide conceptual support for integrating positive mental health promotion into physical activity-based interventions targeting college students’ depressive symptoms, with no causal inferences implied due to the cross-sectional design.
